Canonical readback validates identity and emits no file bytes. Cleanup closes only owned descriptors and clears active state, never path unlinks. Repeated calls release descriptors and use fresh roots. Same capability URL/file SHA256 binding, byte ceiling, three transient transport attempts,1200s/earlier parent deadline remain; no provider workload replay or new authority. Normally at most3status bytes and two empty files plus private directory/inode overhead retained per call until existing finite worker/session filesystem disposal. No isolation against malicious sameUID actor asserted. Namespace replacements are refused without reading/deleting foreign contents.
